notes:
New
• Revisions understand normal talk: "make the rivals logo smaller and lower", "rivals image too big", "music too loud", "this goes away too fast", "the zoom is too strong", even "move dis down" or "make
• One note can ask for several changes: "make that logo smaller, lower it and keep it on screen another second"
• Solis uses what you're looking at: the clip you selected in Premiere first, then what's under the playhead, then names like "rivals"
• While a revision applies, Solis shows what it will do ("Solis will: • Make the Rivals logo smaller • Move it lower")
• Images can be made bigger, smaller, moved and kept on screen longer; one sound can be made quieter or louder; the corner facecam can be resized and moved; a zoom can be made subtler or stronger

Fixed
• "Solis couldn't tell what to change": Solis now only asks when two things really match, and says which ("I found 2 Rivals images: … Which one?")
• Competition Intro cuts all dead space: no held reactions or silences unless your Creative Direction asks for them ("hold his reaction for one second")
• Sound effects play only their sound: silence at the start and end of a file is trimmed, and a sound sheet with several hits plays one
• Each sound's hit lands on its moment (the peak is lined up with the cut, zoom or image)
• No more sliding sounds on zooms or cuts: a slide is only used when something actually slides, at most once
• Overlapping sounds no longer cut each other off
• A revision is checked against Premiere: the changed item is read back, and nothing else may change

Testing
• Try revisions the way you'd say them to an editor and tell us with Send Feedback when Solis gets one wrong
